cards.title: LASER POINTER PRO
cards.concept: laughing night-market loafer in a baggy grey hoodie with a scruffy grey stray kitten perched on his shoulder, aiming a chunky grey laser-pointer gadget with one tiny cyan LED tip held up at his chest
cards.hook: bio: 'professional cat entertainer', and every pro needs his laser pointer

cards.title: GPU REPAIR TECH
cards.concept: grinning street-stall repair tech in a worn grey utility jacket with a cheap earpiece, holding up a scuffed graphics card with a dusty fan at his chest
cards.hook: an engineer at heart, fixing the very GPUs Compute Labs is built on

cards.title: CABLE WRANGLER
cards.concept: cheerful night-shift data-hall crew in grey coveralls with a thick coil of patch cables slung over one shoulder and a lanyard badge hanging at his chest
cards.hook: years at AWS, where the cloud is really miles of cable in data halls

cards.title: CAPSULE CONCIERGE
cards.concept: beaming capsule-hotel concierge in a grey high-collared uniform with a wrist display, a neat stack of folded towels held at his chest with a keycard tucked on top
cards.hook: Airbnb alum, still finding every night owl a place to crash

cards.title: SNEAKERNET RUNNER
cards.concept: grinning data courier in a grey windbreaker with a messenger-bag strap across his chest, hugging a chunky armoured hard drive and wearing a cheap earpiece
cards.hook: big data at Apple, AWS and Airbnb: sometimes the fastest network is a guy with a drive

cards.title: CAT DRONE JOCKEY
cards.concept: laughing drone jockey in grey-green techwear holding a handheld controller with green-lit sticks at his chest while a small cat-eared quadcopter drone hovers beside his shoulder
cards.hook: the professional cat entertainer, now flying the cat toys by remote

cards.title: BIG DATA RUNNER
cards.concept: netrunner in a dark hoodie with green terminal-code trim, a compact cyberdeck strapped at his chest and a coiled green data cable running up to a small implant on his temple
cards.hook: AI and big data engineering at Apple, AWS and Airbnb, jacked straight into the stream

cards.title: GPU OVERCLOCKER
cards.concept: grinning overclocker in a sleeveless grey tech vest with green circuit trim, a small heat-sink implant on the back of one hand, holding up a GPU whose twin fans glow terminal green
cards.hook: the CTO of a company that tokenises GPUs knows how to squeeze out every last flop

cards.title: APPLE CORE HACKER
cards.concept: hardware hacker in a navy utility jacket with green circuit-trace patches, holding up an open-cased apple-shaped chip board with its core glowing green and a thin cyan probe cable attached
cards.hook: engineering years at Apple, now cracking open cores of every kind

cards.title: AI WHISPERER
cards.concept: calm-smiling AI whisperer in a sleek black long coat with glowing teal seams and a teal-lit mic collar at his neck, a faintly glowing cyan neural-net lattice hovering behind one shoulder like a companion
cards.hook: AI engineer with a stated passion for AGI: the models listen when he talks

cards.title: TENSOR SAMURAI
cards.concept: street samurai in a teal-seamed armoured jacket with a high collar, a holo-katana with a faint cyan light blade resting over one shoulder behind his head
cards.hook: AI engineering at Apple, AWS and Airbnb, sharpened into a blade

cards.title: GPU FIXER
cards.concept: sharp-dressed fixer in a black armoured long coat with glowing teal seams and a teal tie, flicking a faintly glowing cyan GPU card between two fingers at chest height like a trump card, confident laugh
cards.hook: cofounder of Compute Labs, which turns GPUs into tokenised assets: need compute, he knows a guy

cards.title: CHROME ARCHITECT
cards.concept: chrome-augmented architect with polished chrome shoulder plates edged in violet neon, three large violet holographic system-diagram panels floating behind his shoulders; huge joyful open-mouthed laugh, eyes squeezed into happy crescents, round face, short thick black hair
cards.hook: cofounder and CTO: the one who architects the whole stack

cards.title: HOLO-CAT OVERLORD
cards.concept: laughing overlord in ornate black-and-chrome cybernetic armour with hot-pink neon trim, a huge holographic hot-pink cyber-cat curled behind his shoulders with violet neon sigils rising above it; huge open-mouthed laugh, eyes squeezed into happy crescents, round face, short thick black hair
cards.hook: the professional cat entertainer, promoted to keeper of an AI-grade cat

cards.title: SINGULARITY CTO
cards.concept: ascended CTO in gold-and-white chrome regalia with a high collar, a crown-halo of glowing golden GPU cores and circuit rings floating high above his head and wings of golden data light rising behind his shoulders; huge joyful open-mouthed laugh, eyes squeezed into happy crescents, round face, short thick black hair, the laughing face the clear focal point
cards.hook: a CTO passionate about AGI, building the compute that gets us there
